snippet.title: I'm making a game where you gamble with your life
snippet.description:
➤  WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489300/Blackout_Jack?utm_source=devlog1

➤  JOIN THE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/aU5naj2fgY

First devlog for Blackout Jack! A blackjack inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder fused with a grimdark murder conspiracy. Gamble your life, build a deck with powerful synergies and combos, and form the perfect plan to kill the dealer before he kills you.

--------------------------------------------
Chapters
0:00 Intro
1:07 Idea
2:37 Making the Dealer
5:22 How to Make Blackjack Fun
11:10 Pascaline
12:43 Making The City
15:37 More Playtesting
17:26 UX Improvements
18:15 Where I Am Now

--------------------------------------------
